source_lanes.purpose: Versioned racecards, explicit horse/race IDs, going, declared runners and later results
source_lanes.gate: Confirm plan, endpoint schema, vintage semantics, quotas and update cadence before scheduling

source_lanes.purpose: Market definitions, scheduled times, selection IDs, quotes, unsigned traded activity and suspensions
source_lanes.candidate: Current offline Betfair samples; later an appropriately licensed streaming source
source_lanes.gate: Historical samples are not live; personal Live App Key is not a generic read-only data subscription

source_lanes.purpose: Discover linked article metadata; not verified event facts or complete racing coverage
source_lanes.candidate: Direct GOV.UK equine Atom and Met Office news RSS
source_lanes.gate: Enabled context feeds only; racing-specific publisher adapters remain held pending suitable access and source policy

source_lanes.purpose: Forecast-vintage weather and official course/going updates
source_lanes.candidate: Met Office and licensed official race/course feeds
source_lanes.gate: Do not substitute later observed weather or revised going for the earlier published forecast

receipt_contract.first_seen_clock: our actual collector receipt, preserved across retries and revisions
receipt_contract.provider_first_seen_clock: separate nullable provider field; not silently mapped to published_at
receipt_contract.exact_retry: same receipt identity, no duplicate revision
receipt_contract.changed_article: new immutable metadata version with its own received time
receipt_contract.same_story_other_outlet: separate source record with later optional syndication relation
receipt_contract.full_text: not stored by current metadata starter; provider/publisher rights needed for any later text ingestion

proposed_production_controls.polling: bounded concurrency, explicit source budget, backoff with jitter and Retry-After, overlapping windows and pagination audit
proposed_production_controls.streaming: persistent worker, resume token when supported, full image after reconnect, gap markers and no silent continuity assumption
proposed_production_controls.queue: at-least-once delivery; acknowledge after durable commit; deterministic idempotency keys
proposed_production_controls.raw_storage: compressed objects only where retention is permitted; lifecycle by source entitlement; not individual exchange ticks in Postgres
proposed_production_controls.entity_links: explicit source/race/market/selection IDs, link_known_at and version; ambiguous names remain unlinked
proposed_production_controls.analysis: evidence-bounded facts, alternative explanation, model/prompt version, analysis_completed_at, uncertainty and expiry
